items.title: Header copy
items.description: The headline is generic and could describe any coffee brand. Fréscopa headlines should lead with craft and precision, and keep to a short, confident sentence.

suggestion.label: Header copy
suggestion.issue: The headline is generic and could describe any coffee brand. Fréscopa headlines should lead with craft and precision, and keep to a short, confident sentence.
suggestion.suggested: Rewrite the headline to lead with Fréscopa's craft-and-precision positioning, for example "Crafted with care. Poured with precision."

evidence.anchorText: Born from a passion for exceptional coffee.
evidence.replacement: Crafted with care. Poured with precision.

items.title: Tone of voice
items.description: The headline reads as a corporate origin story. The brand voice is warm, personal and conversational rather than formal.

suggestion.label: Tone of voice
suggestion.issue: The headline reads as a corporate origin story. The brand voice is warm, personal and conversational rather than formal.
suggestion.suggested: Use a warmer, more personal phrasing such as "Born from a love of exceptional coffee."

context.description: Brand voice guideline: Tone of voice

evidence.anchorText: Born from a passion for exceptional coffee.
evidence.replacement: Born from a love of exceptional coffee.

items.title: Body copy
items.description: The closing phrase of the paragraph relies on a vague, overused claim ("something truly memorable") instead of a concrete benefit.

suggestion.label: Body copy
suggestion.issue: The closing phrase of the paragraph relies on a vague, overused claim ("something truly memorable") instead of a concrete benefit.
suggestion.suggested: Replace the vague closing with a concrete, sensory benefit.

evidence.anchorText: elevate everyday coffee into something truly memorable
evidence.replacement: turn every cup into a small ritual worth savoring

items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: The eyebrow "Our Story" is a generic label. Eyebrows should name the content theme in the brand's own terms.

suggestion.label: Eyebrow
suggestion.issue: The eyebrow "Our Story" is a generic label. Eyebrows should name the content theme in the brand's own terms.
suggestion.suggested: Use an eyebrow that names the theme of the section, e.g. "The Fréscopa Craft".

items.title: Unsubstantiated claims
items.description: The page makes an absolute superlative claim ("the world's best coffee machines") that is not substantiated and is not allowed by the claims policy.

suggestion.label: Unsubstantiated claims
suggestion.issue: The page makes an absolute superlative claim ("the world's best coffee machines") that is not substantiated and is not allowed by the claims policy.
suggestion.suggested: Remove the superlative or support it with a verifiable, citable fact.

context.description: Legal and claims guideline: Unsubstantiated claims

items.title: Call to action
items.description: The page does not offer a clear next step. Brand pages should end the hero section with one primary call to action.

suggestion.label: Call to action
suggestion.issue: The page does not offer a clear next step. Brand pages should end the hero section with one primary call to action.
suggestion.suggested: Add a single primary call to action such as "Explore our machines" below the introduction.

context.description: Page structure guideline: Call to action

items.title: Image
items.description: The hero image uses a cool, desaturated look that conflicts with the warm, natural photography style of the brand.

suggestion.label: Image
suggestion.issue: The hero image uses a cool, desaturated look that conflicts with the warm, natural photography style of the brand.
suggestion.suggested: Replace the hero image with a warm, natural-light photograph that shows coffee being prepared by hand.

items.title: Brand name usage
items.description: The brand name "Fréscopa" is written with the accented é in every occurrence.
